The CoreDNS Helm release must wait for modify_kube_dns to apply Helm ownership annotations to the existing kube-dns service. Waiting only for remove_default_coredns_deployment allows installation to race those annotations and fail ownership validation.

Prometheus installs into local.namespace_name without waiting for the separately managed prometheus namespace; with AMP disabled there is no ordering path to namespace creation. Wire the namespace into helm_config.
The ADOT EKS add-on waits for roles but not the role binding granting those permissions to eks:addon-manager. It should wait for the binding before provisioning the operator.
The ADOT EKS add-on must wait for the cluster role binding granting eks:addon-manager cluster-wide installation permissions; referencing the ClusterRole alone does not wait for this grant.
